about: One good panorama per eyeball-set pand (lane PR1; docs/house-line.md §14). house:frames uses `pano` whenever --list or --pands names the pand (the entry's own notPanos are added; --no-pinned-poses ignores this file). notPanos are the captures judged bad. Picked 2026-11-13 by eye from every capture earlier frames runs drew for the pand.
